## What it does — the source's own header, verbatim

```
gr28.c - Grid Reorder mod for F1 Challenge 99-02

Fork of gr27.c. Bug fixes:
 - install_hook() now guards against double-install (was corrupting g_orig_bytes)
 - Phase 3 now always calls remove_hook()+remove_hook2() on exit, not just after
   RETIRE_SECS — preventing stale hook crash on early RacePhase transition.

Original gr27 additions during the 30s red-flag countdown:

 1. AI speed cap — writes maxSpeed (+0x4538) per AI vehicle.
    Offset source: F1CUI bytecode (driverMemoryAddress - 476 = struct + 0x4538).
    IDA: 2 xrefs confirmed. Original values saved and restored before restart.
    Cap value: VSC_SPEED_CAP (20.0f). Logged vs original so units are visible.

 2. No-overtaking enforcement — race position (+0x4060) snapshotted at button press;
    re-written every 50ms during countdown to prevent cars from changing order.

POKE-PROVE STATUS:
  - +0x4538 maxSpeed: IDA-confirmed (2 xrefs), NOT yet live-poke-proven.
    DLL logs original values and read-back so failure is detectable.
  - +0x4060 RacePos write: confirmed in docs/26 (position field), live write unproven.
    DLL logs if positions drift during enforcement.

Build:
  C:\msys64\mingw32\bin\gcc.exe -shared -O2 -o gr28.dll gr28.c -lkernel32
Inject:
  mods\red-flag-dll\inject.exe mods\grid_reorder\gr28.dll
```
